description: NaVO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.68 Å. V is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-2.02 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one V atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one V atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na and three equivalent V atoms.
